bio: A fun place to eat! This handsome historical half-timbered house has been in the same family since 1750. Sit back in the delightful wood-panelled interior as the cordial front-of-house team brings out really good Baden cuisine, which can also be enjoyed on the terrace in summer. The menu includes dishes such as pikeperch-salmon dumplings, and stuffed guinea fowl breast with a chive cream sauce to whet your appetite. Tip: Sample the tempting little starters and desserts (look for the Versucherle sections on the menu)! With some 500 labels, the wine list is excellent. To take home: house-made cherry and plum brandies. The establishment also has well-kept guestrooms....
